title: Conformance case expected result
description: The _id list every binding's query.json must produce, in order.

ids.description: Document _id values, in the exact order Find() must return them.

fields.description: Optional. Document fields to check beyond _id/order, e.g. ["_id", "age", "name"]. nosqlite has no projection support, so this doesn't change the query — the runner takes the full documents Find() already returns and narrows each one down to these fields before comparing against `docs`. Present only to make expected.json readable; omit for id-order-only cases.

docs.description: Required if `fields` is set. One object per id in `ids`, same order, containing only the keys listed in `fields`.
